doc.title: Joe Wilder Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: First big band: Les Hite, then Lionel Hampton
summary: His first name band was Les Hite, with Dizzy Gillespie and the Woodman brothers; he moved to Hampton by 1943, when he entered the service.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: How about your first big band experience? You’ve played in so many big bands.

The first big band I played with, a name orchestra, was Les Hite. I played in that band and during the time I was in that band Dizzy Gillespie also joined it, Britt Woodman was the first trombone player, and Gerald Wiggins, Britt Woodman and his brother Coney, who was our pianist, were drafted at the same time. And Gerald Wiggins joined the band. He was in the band at the time Dizzy Gillespie was in the band for a short time.
Did you get to do some traveling at that point, around the country, did you travel?

Yes, we traveled quite a bit, right. And from that band, I finally went, I joined Lionel Hampton’s band from Les Hite’s band. And I was in Lionel Hampton’s band in 1943 at the time I went into the service.
